# a placed table has a block entity without a name and no update packet
BE 0 -60 0 {components:{},id:"minecraft:enchanting_table",x:0,y:-60,z:0}
BEU 0 -60 0 -
# custom name through NBT (valid, replaced, malformed, cleared)
BE 0 -60 0 {CustomName:"Fancy table",components:{},id:"minecraft:enchanting_table",x:0,y:-60,z:0}
BEU 0 -60 0 -
BE 0 -60 0 {CustomName:{bold:1b,color:"gold",text:"Gold"},components:{},id:"minecraft:enchanting_table",x:0,y:-60,z:0}
BE 0 -60 0 {components:{},id:"minecraft:enchanting_table",x:0,y:-60,z:0}
BE 2 -60 0 {CustomName:"Kept",components:{},id:"minecraft:enchanting_table",x:2,y:-60,z:0}
CHUNKBES 0 0
BEP 0 -60 0 minecraft:enchanting_table
BEP 2 -60 0 minecraft:enchanting_table
# an item with a custom name names the placed table
B 4 -60 0 minecraft:enchanting_table
BE 4 -60 0 {CustomName:"Named by item",components:{},id:"minecraft:enchanting_table",x:4,y:-60,z:0}
# breaking a named table drops the table with its name (copy_components); an unnamed table drops a plain item
